definitions.explanation: What a company spends to push sales of a product: campaigns, samples, in-store displays, coupons, and similar activity. A shortening of {販売促進費|はんばいそくしんひ}, and treated as a distinct line item in a budget.

examples.japanese: {販促費|はんそくひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{削|けず}る→削る：03922_kezuru⟧ことになった。
examples.english: It was decided to cut the sales promotion budget.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年度|こんねんど}→今年度：28220_konnendo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{販促費|はんそくひ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{昨年度|さくねんど}⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: This fiscal year's promotional budget is larger than last year's.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新商品|しんしょうひん}→新商品：11504_shinshouhin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{販促費|はんそくひ}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧、{三千万円|さんぜんまんえん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{計上|けいじょう}→計上：08006_keijou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Thirty million yen was budgeted as promotional expenses for the new product.

examples.japanese: ⟦{売上|うりあげ}→売上：04102_uriage⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{伸|の}びなかった→伸びる：01974_nobiru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{販促費|はんそくひ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{使|つか}い{方|かた}→使い方：07797_tsukaikata⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧だ。
examples.english: Sales did not grow because there was a problem with how the promotional budget was spent.

notes:
An abbreviation of ⟦{販売促進費|はんばいそくしんひ}→販売促進費：30209_hanbaisokushinhi⟧. The short form is what appears in budget spreadsheets and internal discussion; the full form is used in formal accounting documents.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {販促費|はんそくひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{削減|さくげん}する→削減する：25399_sakugensuru⟧: to cut promotional spending
- {販促費|はんそくひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧: to spend money on promotion
- {販促費|はんそくひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{計上|けいじょう}→計上：08006_keijou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to budget for promotional expenses

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{広告費|こうこくひ}→広告費：30159_koukokuhi⟧: advertising expenses — money spent on ads themselves, a narrower category
- ⟦{経費|けいひ}→経費：04696_keihi⟧: business expenses — the general term covering all company spending
